about: Jobs of `pnpm assets` (scripts/assets/pipeline.mjs). Each .blend is exported into one glb per area of its object names (A1_… → a1.glb, CM_… → common.glb) in `out`, then compressed. The lab sample is S-23's; the workshop (序章「工房」の内装) is S-24's, made by blender/scripts/make_workshop.py. `bake` (S-26): the light and shadow of the opaque pieces baked by Cycles into one lightmap per area (blender/scripts/pipeline.py, common/bake.py): its size (px), samples, the percentile its brightness is normalized by (common/bake.py; 99.9 lets the floor right under the furnace's fire clip so the dim room keeps its steps in 8 bits), the margin (px) round each island, the KTX2 codec of the lightmap (uastc: the owner chose it at S-26's integration over etc1s, whose 4×4 blocks showed on smooth surfaces close by), and the texel density of the pieces seen large or close (the floor; the bench under the skylight in the first picture; the furnace, the marver and the annealer). The time it takes is in process/slices/S-26.md (2048 px, 512 samples: about 50 s on Metal). `BAKE=0 pnpm assets` (or `-- --no-bake`) exports without it.
